text_block_list.text: I head to the cafeteria for lunch, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I forgot it! The source of all my power...
my
special Salsa de la Vida!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I can't work up my super spicy energy
without it...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:

not gonna
be able to do anything.
